title: Spinner Gerunds Obnoxious
body: PLEASE can you enter a flag to remove those words that go along the spinner? I need to clear up them all the time and it's taking lots of valuable time for non-English users. Thanks a lot for your kind attention.
author: ZeldOcarina

top_comments.author: github-actions[bot]
top_comments.body: This issue has been inactive for 30 days. If the issue is still occurring, please comment to let us know. Otherwise, this issue will be automatically closed in 30 days for housekeeping purposes.

top_comments.author: polarnice
top_comments.body: Agreed, the gerunds are annoying after a while, would be nice to be able to disable.
